text: Hello, I think I just need a quick bit of advice on dosing. My stepdaughter is 11 and she's been feeling a bit rubbish since yesterday. I'm not sure whether at her age it goes by age or by weight for paracetamol and ibuprofen, and whether I can give both or should stick to one. She weighs around 35kg I believe. For what it's worth, there's no rash on her at all, I had a look, and nothing like a fit or shaking, nothing like that. Just want to make sure I'm giving the right amount before I give anything.
